@9853 := "# Generated by `verdant-studio publish` from studio/src/Studio/Ops.lex.tex. Do not edit.\nname: pages\n\non:\n  pull_request:\n  push:\n    branches: [main]\n\npermissions:\n  contents: read\n\nconcurrency:\n  group: pages-${{ github.ref }}\n  cancel-in-progress: true\n\njobs:\n  studio:\n    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04\n    timeout-minutes: 30\n    permissions:\n      contents: read\n      pull-requests: read\n    steps:\n      - uses: actions/checkout@11bd71901bbe5b1630ceea73d27597364c9af683 # v4.2.2\n        with:\n          persist-credentials: false\n      - uses: actions/setup-node@249970729cb0ef3589644e2896645e5dc5ba9c38\n        with:\n          node-version: '24'\n      - id: command\n        uses: actions/cache@5a3ec84eff668545956fd18022155c47e93e2684 # v4.2.3\n        with:\n          path: |\n            target/release/verdant_studio\n            target/release/verdant_readers\n          key: verdant-studio-${{ hashFiles('certified/**', 'certified-readers/**') }}\n      - uses: actions/cache@5a3ec84eff668545956fd18022155c47e93e2684 # v4.2.3\n        with:\n          path: ~/.npm\n          key: npm-prism-code-0.11.1\n      - if: steps.command.outputs.cache-hit != 'true'\n        uses: actions/cache@5a3ec84eff668545956fd18022155c47e93e2684 # v4.2.3\n        with:\n          path: target/lexlean\n          key: lexlean-0.4.3\n      - name: replay the certified bundle, then build its command (only when certified/ changed)\n        if: steps.command.outputs.cache-hit != 'true'\n        run: |\n          set -euo pipefail\n          test -x target/lexlean/bin/lexlean || cargo install --locked --version 0.4.3 lexlean --root target/lexlean\n          target/lexlean/bin/lexlean production verify-artifact certified\n          cargo build --release --manifest-path certified/packages/rust-std/verdant_studio/Cargo.toml --target-dir target\n          # The reader operations are a second LexLean project with its own bundle, so that each export stays under its limits.\n          if [ -d certified-readers ]; then\n            target/lexlean/bin/lexlean production verify-artifact certified-readers\n            cargo build --release --manifest-path certified-readers/packages/rust-std/verdant_readers/Cargo.toml --target-dir target && rm -f certified-readers/packages/rust-std/verdant_readers/Cargo.lock\n          fi\n          # Building may write only target/: a stray file in a bundle fails verify-artifact on the next run (LLV7102).\n          if [ -n \"$(git status --porcelain -- certified certified-readers)\" ]; then\n            echo \"::error::building the certified commands left files in certified/ or certified-readers/:\"\n            git status --short -- certified certified-readers | head -20\n            exit 1\n          fi\n      - name: check, build and publish through the API\n        run: |\n          set -euo pipefail\n          target/release/verdant_studio check\n          # Each encoding admitted through admit-translated recorded the reader command that printed it: run it again and fail if the output differs.\n          target/release/verdant_readers verify-translations model/admissions.json\n          target/release/verdant_studio build\n          target/release/verdant_studio publish\n          if ! git diff --quiet; then echo \"::error::publish changed $(git diff --name-only | tr '\\n' ' '): run every operation through operate, which ends with check, build and publish\"; exit 1; fi\n      - name: next answers within a second, because operate's advance runs it on every push to main\n        run: |\n          set -euo pipefail\n          best=999999\n          for attempt in 1 2 3; do\n            start=$EPOCHREALTIME\n            target/release/verdant_studio next > target/next.txt || true\n            end=$EPOCHREALTIME\n            took=$(( (${end/./} - ${start/./}) / 1000 ))\n            if [ \"$took\" -lt \"$best\" ]; then best=$took; fi\n          done\n          echo \"next took ${best} ms, the best of 3 runs\"\n          if [ \"$best\" -gt 1000 ]; then echo \"::error::next took ${best} ms, over its 1 s budget: make the reads it repeats cheaper before adding more\"; exit 1; fi\n      - if: github.event_name == 'pull_request'\n        uses: actions/cache@5a3ec84eff668545956fd18022155c47e93e2684 # v4.2.3\n        with:\n          path: ~/.elan\n          key: lean-4.32.2-elan-4.1.2\n      - name: run propose-command end to end when the pull request changes the API's own workflows\n        if: github.event_name == 'pull_request'\n        env:\n          BASE: ${{ github.base_ref }}\n        run: |\n          set -euo pipefail\n          # The studio check proves the model and replays the certified bundle, but the API's own paths\n          # run in these workflows. So a change to them must pass operate's propose-command step itself,\n          # on a fixture change, and that export must reproduce certified/ byte for byte.\n          git fetch -q --depth=1 origin \"$BASE\"\n          if git diff --quiet FETCH_HEAD -- .github; then echo \"the workflows are main's, which main's own runs exercise\"; exit 0; fi\n          mkdir -p target\n          python3 -c 'import yaml; steps = yaml.safe_load(open(\".github/workflows/operate.yml\"))[\"jobs\"][\"operate\"][\"steps\"]; print([step[\"run\"] for step in steps if step.get(\"name\", \"\").startswith(\"apply a change\")][0])' > target/propose.sh\n          d=dev\n          none=null\n          {\n            echo \"Fixture change for the studio check's end-to-end run of propose-command.\"\n            echo\n            echo \"diff --git a/features/suites/e2e.fixture b/features/suites/e2e.fixture\"\n            echo \"new file mode 100644\"\n            echo \"--- /$d/$none\"\n            echo \"+++ b/features/suites/e2e.fixture\"\n            echo \"@@ -0,0 +1 @@\"\n            echo \"+fixture\"\n          } > target/fixture.patch\n          INPUT=\"$(cat target/fixture.patch)\" bash target/propose.sh\n          rm -f features/suites/e2e.fixture\n          if [ -n \"$(git status --porcelain -- certified certified-readers)\" ]; then\n            echo \"::error::operate's propose-command step ran, but its export did not reproduce certified/:\"\n            git status --short -- certified certified-readers | head -20\n            exit 1\n          fi\n          echo \"propose-command applied the fixture, exported again with Lean and reproduced certified/ byte for byte\"\n      - name: accept only pull requests made through the API (last, so every seal step reports first)\n        if: github.event_name == 'pull_request'\n        env:\n          GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}\n          PR: ${{ github.event.pull_request.number }}\n          AUTHOR: ${{ github.event.pull_request.user.login }}\n        run: |\n          set -euo pipefail\n          app='afflom-verdant-studio[bot]'\n          if [ \"$AUTHOR\" != \"$app\" ]; then\n            echo \"::error title=provenance::$AUTHOR opened this pull request, not $app through operate. Every seal step above passed; only the provenance gate refuses it.\"\n            exit 1\n          fi\n          others=$(gh api \"repos/${GITHUB_REPOSITORY}/pulls/${PR}/commits\" --paginate --jq \".[] | select(.author.login != \\\"$app\\\") | .sha\")\n          if [ -n \"$others\" ]; then\n            echo \"::error::these commits were not made by $app: $others\"\n            exit 1\n          fi\n      - if: github.event_name == 'push'\n        uses: actions/upload-pages-artifact@56afc609e74202658d3ffba0e8f6dda462b719fa # v3.0.1\n        with:\n          path: app/.prism/site\n\n  pages:\n    if: github.event_name == 'push'\n    needs: studio\n    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04\n    permissions:\n      pages: write\n      id-token: write\n    environment:\n      name: github-pages\n      url: ${{ steps.deployment.outputs.page_url }}\n    steps:\n      - id: deployment\n        uses: actions/deploy-pages@d6db90164ac5ed86f2b6aed7e0febac5b3c0c03e # v4.0.5\n"

@9973 := "#!/usr/bin/env bash\n# Generated by `verdant-studio publish` from studio/src/Studio/Ops.lex.tex. Do not edit.\n# The one Lean export of the certified command. operate's propose-command and refresh both run it,\n# and the studio check runs propose-command end to end, so a change that breaks it fails there.\n# Export time is a requirement: every Lean phase runs under child_timeout_ms (300 s, studio/lexlean.toml),\n# so this script measures each phase and fails at 240 s, 80 percent of that limit, before time can creep up to it.\nset -euo pipefail\nll=\"$1\"\nlog=\"$2\"\nphases=\"$log.phases\"\n: > \"$phases.raw\"\n( while :; do ps -eo etimes=,args= | awk '$2 == \"lean\" && $3 == \"-R\" { m = $NF; sub(\".*-src/\", \"\", m); print $1, m }' >> \"$phases.raw\" || true; sleep 1; done ) &\nwatch=$!\nstatus=0\n# Each LexLean project exports in parallel under its own limits: studio, and readers when it exists.\npids=\"\"\nfor project in studio readers; do\n  if [ -f \"$project/lexlean.toml\" ]; then\n    (cd \"$project\" && \"$ll\" lock && \"$ll\" check && \"$ll\" production build --request production-request.json) > \"$log.$project\" 2>&1 &\n    pids=\"$pids $!\"\n  fi\ndone\nfor pid in $pids; do wait \"$pid\" || status=$?; done\ncat \"$log.studio\" > \"$log\"\nif [ -f \"$log.readers\" ]; then cat \"$log.readers\" >> \"$log\"; fi\nkill \"$watch\" 2> \"$phases.err\" || true\nawk '{ if ($1 > t[$2]) t[$2] = $1 } END { for (m in t) print t[m], m }' \"$phases.raw\" | sort -rn > \"$phases\"\necho \"Lean phases by wall time in seconds, longest first (the limit is 300, and the export fails at 240):\"\nhead -n 8 \"$phases\"\nif [ \"$status\" -ne 0 ]; then exit \"$status\"; fi\nworst=$(head -n 1 \"$phases\" | cut -d ' ' -f 1)\nif [ -n \"$worst\" ] && [ \"$worst\" -ge 240 ]; then\n  echo \"::error::a Lean phase took ${worst} s, within 20 percent of the 300 s limit: make its declarations cheaper to prove before adding more\"\n  exit 1\nfi\nrm -rf certified\ncp -r studio/.lexlean/production/*/ certified\nrm -f certified/packages/rust-std/verdant_studio/Cargo.lock\n\"$ll\" production verify-artifact certified\nif [ -f readers/lexlean.toml ]; then\n  rm -rf certified-readers\n  cp -r readers/.lexlean/production/*/ certified-readers\n  rm -f certified-readers/packages/rust-std/verdant_readers/Cargo.lock\n  \"$ll\" production verify-artifact certified-readers\nfi\n"

@17115 := "            # The repair of a merge that broke the API's own path. Dispatched from a branch at the last\n"
@17116 := @762 @17115
@17117 := @761 @17116
@17119 := @572 @17117 @545
@17120 := @760 @17119
@17121 := @572 @17120
@17122 := "            # good main commit, it reverts the merge on main as the App, and merges once the studio check passes.\n"
@17123 := @762 @17122

@17126 := @572 @17124 @545

@17133 := @572 @17131 @545
@17134 := @760 @17133
@17135 := @572 @17134
@17136 := "            case \"$merge\" in *[!0-9a-f]*|'') echo \"::error::revert-merge takes the full hex id of a merge commit on main\"; exit 1;; esac\n"
@17137 := @762 @17136
@17138 := @761 @17137

@17147 := @572 @17145 @545

@17154 := @572 @17152 @545
@17155 := @760 @17154
@17156 := @572 @17155
@17157 := "            if ! git merge-base --is-ancestor \"$merge\" origin/main; then echo \"::error::$merge is not on main\"; exit 1; fi\n"
@17158 := @762 @17157
@17159 := @761 @17158
@17161 := @572 @17159 @545

@17163 := @572 @17162

@17168 := @572 @17166 @545
@17169 := @760 @17168
@17170 := @572 @17169
@17171 := "            cargo build -q --release --manifest-path certified/packages/rust-std/verdant_studio/Cargo.toml --target-dir target\n"

@17175 := @572 @17173 @545
@17176 := @760 @17175
@17177 := @572 @17176
@17178 := "            if [ -d certified-readers ]; then cargo build -q --release --manifest-path certified-readers/packages/rust-std/verdant_readers/Cargo.toml --target-dir target && rm -f certified-readers/packages/rust-std/verdant_readers/Cargo.lock; fi\n"

@17180 := @761 @17179
@17182 := @572 @17180 @545
@17183 := @760 @17182
@17184 := @572 @17183
@17185 := "            { echo \"Revert $merge, a merge that broke the API's own path\"; echo; echo \"**What changes and why.** This reverts the merge $merge on main $(git rev-parse --short origin/main), made by the App from the last good main commit, so the repair needs no bypass.\"; echo; echo '```'; git diff --cached --stat -- studio/src app/src model features README.md .github; echo '```'; } > target/operation.txt\n"

@17196 := @572 @17194 @545

@17243 := @761 @17242
@17245 := @572 @17243 @545
@17246 := @760 @17245
@17247 := @572 @17246
@17248 := "          if git diff --cached --quiet; then echo \"no change\"; exit 0; fi\n"

@17252 := @572 @17250 @545

@17254 := @572 @17253

@17259 := @572 @17257 @545

@17261 := @572 @17260

@17264 := @761 @17263
@17266 := @572 @17264 @545
@17267 := @760 @17266
@17268 := @572 @17267

@17273 := @572 @17271 @545

@17275 := @572 @17274

@17280 := @572 @17278 @545

@17282 := @572 @17281

@17285 := @761 @17284
@17287 := @572 @17285 @545

@17331 := @572 @17330

@17344 := @760 @17343
@17345 := @572 @17344

@17378 := @572 @17376 @545

@17380 := @572 @17379
